item.title: Verbose beta 263
item.description:
Tidy brain dump tasks, and Send to Verbose Tasks

Mac

  • Plan my day writes each task as a short to-do, without the ums, repeats, and reasons. "make a to make a call with Rob about the props in" becomes "Make a call with Rob about the props". Plans you already made are tidied too.

Also on iPhone

  • Send tasks can send to Verbose Tasks when it's installed.

Release notes on GitHub
